verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation is a fair axis for a GPU used for compute. The only relevant evidence is indirect: NVIDIA ships CUDA containers via NGC for GPU-accelerated applications, and Phoronix ran 60+ CUDA/OptiX/OpenCL/Vulkan Linux compute benchmarks on the card. Both imply scripted, display-less compute use, but neither explicitly documents headless or CI operation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of headless or display-less operation, CI/runner integration guidance (e.g., container GPU passthrough), and hands-on reports of the 5090 running in automated pipelines.
